subject: general
question: What is the simple interest (in Rs.) on Rs. 540 at 6% per annum in 3(1)/(2) years?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = Rs. 540

Rate (R) = 6%

Time(T) = 3(1)/(2) years.

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T)/100

**Calculation:**

According to question,

SI = (540 × 6 × 7)/100 × 2

⇒ (42 × 27)/100

⇒ 113.40

 **∴ The simple interest (in Rs.) on Rs. 540 at 6% per annum in ****3(1)/(2) years is 113.40.**
